name: How do I choose the right type of ramp for my home's accessibility needs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of ramp for my home's accessibility needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right ramp involves considering the user's specific needs, the rise (height difference), available space, budget, and aesthetic preferences. Options include modular ramps (prefabricated sections), portable ramps (temporary use), and custom-built ramps (permanent solutions). Factors like slope, width, load capacity, and slip resistance are crucial. Consulting with a general contractor can help you assess your needs, understand local accessibility codes, and design a ramp that is safe, functional, and blends with your home's design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider user needs, rise, space, budget, and aesthetics. Options include modular, portable, or custom-built. A contractor can guide selection for safety and compliance.
